pageSubtitle: Browse, install and update MWEF plugins from a GitHub-hosted source
sourceSecurityTip: Indexes and packages are untrusted input. Size, SHA-256, package structure and permissions are checked before installation.
localInstallHint: Local uploads, permission changes and recovery copies remain available in Framework Settings.

sourceWarning: The new index is fetched and validated before saving. A custom source can publish code with router-level privileges; use only sources you trust.
